parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the toggle switch part of a wall switch, made of durable plastic and designed for frequent manual operation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator that opens or closes the electrical circuit, turning the connected device on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks back and forth around a central axis to change the electrical state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or faceplate of the wall switch, made of insulating plastic and mounted to the wall.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switch mechanism and covers the electrical box for safety and aesthetics.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
